findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 4102368f799e8553491a9aa892bcf6e20bbe3c56, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff shows this replaced `return userTenant === documentTenant;`, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
